findings.address_as_written: General Manager's Report - Zoo Elephant Exhibit
findings.description: The renovated Asian Elephant Exhibit at the Zoo was dedicated on January 10, 1991, with sand in the outdoor yard and heated floors in the night quarters, as the Zoo moved to a "hands off" way of managing its elephants.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, January 17, 1991

findings.address_as_written: Portsmouth Square schematic plan, Phase II
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved the schematic plan for the second phase of Portsmouth Square's master plan, covering the upper plaza: raised planters with benches around its edge, 64 new trees, light gray granite paving, and restoration of the schoolhouse monument, the Stevenson monument and the plaza's other monuments, with construction hoped for in early 1992.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, November 21, 1991, Resolution No. 16249
